cohort: The cohort consisted of 354 newborns (119 with birth asphyxia and 235 controls) delivered at public health institutions.
finding: The study found that Caesarean section and unclear amniotic fluid significantly increased the odds of birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section mode of delivery was identified as a significant factor contributing to birth asphyxia, increasing the odds by 4.706 times.
